prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a lead hammer head, a lead square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough copper a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and two to three mixed-metal necklaces. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
